name: Drutopia Dev for Find It install profile
description: Submodule of Drutopia Dev targeting the 'Find It' install profile: declares Find It / Features dependencies and installs the Drutopia Features bundle for feature-building on a Find It site.
project_description: Submodule of Drutopia Dev for the 'Find It' install profile. It is independent of the parent drutopia_dev module (and mutually exclusive with it, because both ship an identical features.bundle.drutopia.yml). It declares Find It content and Features/Features UI dependencies and installs the Drutopia Features bundle so feature-builders can package configuration on a Find It site.
